title: Same Cell Organism
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume collection of short boys'-love stories by Sumomo Yumeka. The title story follows high-school boys Nakagawa and Yokota, a loving couple who differ in how openly they show affection but feel 'like same-cell organisms' (Juné blurb via AniList); other stories include two lonely boys at a favorite spot and an angel who follows a boy through his life (MangaUpdates). Database tags describe a gentle, poetic tone with themes of illness and the death of a loved one.
life_message: It suggests that close, accepting love and friendship give comfort through loneliness and loss (to verify).

content.note: Illness and death of a loved one (MangaUpdates).
